boxPolicy: Compute raw IoU for every valid box on present targets, even below existence threshold. Consume a box only when independent existence probability >= 0.5. Absent false positive means a consumed box; count all absent raw boxes separately.
classification: 请选择图片中唯一形状类别；纯白背景选 empty。
existence: 图片中是否存在红色矩形？蓝圆不是红矩形。
localization: 定位这张图片中的红色矩形，四边按图宽高归一化。存在性由另一个问题独立回答。
